_note: REVISION D of the asset registry (operator decision t430u, 2026-10-26). Revision C (deployment/assetRegistry.revC.json, SHA-256 5c3311eb4f7b59c34e7ccc8a6bd9e817b4f0bb02bdeff65c5cfed98f79cca581) with its Base subset replaced by the expanded Base registry. Rows of other environments are history, carried over unchanged, and are not registered by the Base-only ceremony. Built by scripts/buildRevisionD.cjs.

rules.membership: Base entries approved in deployment/baseRegistryCandidate_2026-10-26.csv (EXCLUDED rows skipped) plus TigerOG by founder override (t430u item 5). LionOG and FrogOG removed (t431u). No liquidity-pool minimum, no freshness rule and no market-cap screen (t430u item 1).
rules.pricing: Unchanged scheduled pricing rules: CoinGecko by the row's pricingIdentifier, then DexScreener by the row's own Base contract. A row with no usable price has no valuation for that run (VF-ORC-005). No substitute price.
rules.tel: TEL uses the upgraded Base contract 0x7E13B43065380aCdeC1c2d138c579cbBbafA0731 (t430u item 3); the old Base contract 0x09bE1692ca16e06f536F0038fF11D1dA8524aDB1 is not registered.
